name: Gliff Door
author: Yassine Sawahi
description: Let your other machines remote-desktop into this PC with Gliff, each behind an on/off switch. Their SSH keys can only start gliff-server: no shell, no forwarding, and only from their Tailscale address.

barWidget.description: A switch per machine for who may open this PC with Gliff; the icon lights up while someone is on the screen. Middle-click flips the first machine's switch.
